text.description_html:
Acorn IR8BP, Simple Black Iron Art Drawer Pull

This old world style pull is for lightweight applications of all kinds including cabinet doors, dresser drawers, and armoire doors. Painstakingly crafted out of iron, this cabinet pull--made by Acorn--is constructed by using the techniques of the traditional forge, using an anvil and hammer. The old world design will not go unnoticed in your home. The Acorn IR8BP Simple Iron Cabinet Pulls have a black iron finish which mimics the look of naturally weathered metal. This grants the cabinet pull a richness that is both elegant and timeless.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the 4" Hand Forged Iron Art Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Length: 4"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
